How templates work: [Snippets](/docs/snippets/). Templates run only when `snippets.templates = true`.

Arguments in `[…]` are optional. `n`/`len` arguments are capped at 4096. Every function accepts `default=VALUE`, which replaces a runtime failure with VALUE. System functions always describe the **local** machine, even in an SSH pane. No function spawns a process or touches the network.

## Functions

### Generators

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `uuid [v4\|v7]` | UUID, lowercase hyphenated (default v4; v7 is time-ordered). | `{{ uuid v7 }}` |
| `ulid` | ULID (Crockford base32). | `{{ ulid }}` |
| `nanoid [len=21]` | URL-safe random id. | `{{ nanoid len=12 }}` |
| `random MIN MAX` | Random integer in the inclusive range. | `{{ random 1 6 }}` |
| `random_string LEN [charset=alnum]` | Random string. `charset` is alnum, alpha, lower, upper, digits, hex, or any other string used as the character set. | `{{ random_string 8 charset=hex }}` |
| `password [len=20] [symbols=true]` | Password with at least one lower-case letter, upper-case letter and digit (and a symbol when enabled). | `{{ password len=24 symbols=false }}` |
| `hex N` | N random bytes as 2N hex characters. | `{{ hex 16 }}` |
| `base64_random N` | N random bytes, standard base64. | `{{ base64_random 24 }}` |
| `pick A B …` | One of the arguments, chosen at random (at least one). | `{{ pick "red" "green" "blue" }}` |
| `counter NAME [start=1] [step=1]` | Per-window counter kept in memory. It advances only when an insert succeeds; previews do not advance it. | `{{ counter "build" start=100 }}` |
| `lorem [words=8]` | Lorem-ipsum words. | `{{ lorem words=12 }}` |

### Date and time

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `now [FMT="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"]` | Formatted current time (strftime). Local time zone unless `utc=true`. | `{{ now "%H:%M" utc=true }}` |
| `date` | `%Y-%m-%d`. | `{{ date }}` |
| `time` | `%H:%M:%S`. | `{{ time }}` |
| `timestamp` | Unix epoch seconds. | `{{ timestamp }}` |
| `timestamp_ms` | Unix epoch milliseconds. | `{{ timestamp_ms }}` |
| `iso8601` | RFC 3339 timestamp with the UTC offset. | `{{ iso8601 }}` |
| `date_offset OFFSET [FMT="%Y-%m-%d"]` | Current time shifted by ±N followed by s, m, h, d or w. | `{{ date_offset "-7d" }}` |

### System

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `user` | Login name (passwd entry, not `$USER`). | `{{ user }}` |
| `hostname` | Local host name. | `{{ hostname }}` |
| `os` | `macos` or `linux`. | `{{ os }}` |

| `shell` | The shell microterm spawns. | `{{ shell }}` |

| `cpus` | Available parallelism. | `{{ cpus }}` |

| `local_ip [v4\|v6]` | First non-loopback address of an up interface (`getifaddrs`; no traffic). | `{{ local_ip }}` |
| `microterm_version` | e.g. `1.0.0`. | `{{ microterm_version }}` |

### Terminal and pane

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `cwd` | Working directory (OSC 7, else the process cwd for local panes). Fails when unknown. | `cd {{ cwd \| quote }}` |
| `cwd_basename` | Last component of `cwd`. | `{{ cwd_basename }}` |
| `git_branch` | Current branch (a detached HEAD gives the short SHA). Reads `.git/HEAD` from `cwd` upwards, following worktree `gitdir:` files. Fails for remote panes and outside a repository. | `git push -u origin {{ git_branch }}` |
| `git_root` | Root of the enclosing repository or worktree. Fails for remote panes and outside a repository. | `cd {{ git_root }}` |
| `pane_id` | Numeric pane id, as in `ctl` and `$MICROTERM_PANE`. | `{{ pane_id }}` |
| `tab_id` | Numeric tab id. | `{{ tab_id }}` |
| `window_id` | Numeric window id. | `{{ window_id }}` |
| `tab_index` | 1-based position in the tab bar. | `{{ tab_index }}` |
| `tab_title` | Effective tab title. | `{{ tab_title }}` |
| `pane_title` | Effective pane title. | `{{ pane_title }}` |
| `workspace` | Workspace name. | `{{ workspace }}` |
| `domain` | `local`, or the SSH/serial domain name. | `{{ domain }}` |
| `remote_host` | Host of the pane's SSH domain. Fails for local panes. | `{{ remote_host }}` |
| `cols` | Grid width. | `{{ cols }}` |
| `rows` | Grid height. | `{{ rows }}` |
| `font_family` | Effective font family. Fails headless. | `{{ font_family }}` |
| `font_size` | Effective font size (including the per-window override). Fails headless. | `{{ font_size }}` |
| `theme` | Theme name. Fails headless. | `{{ theme }}` |
| `fg_process` | Foreground process name. Fails for remote panes. | `{{ fg_process }}` |
| `shell_pid` | Shell pid. Fails for remote panes. | `{{ shell_pid }}` |
| `last_command [n=1]` | Command line of the n-th last OSC 133 command. Fails without shell integration. | `{{ last_command }}` |
| `last_output [n=1]` | Output of the n-th last OSC 133 command, capped at `ctl.capture_max_bytes` (the tail is kept). Fails without shell integration. | `{{ last_output \| trim }}` |
| `selection` | Selected text in the pane, `""` if none. Fails headless. | `grep -rn {{ selection \| quote }} .` |
| `clipboard` | System clipboard text, `""` if empty. Fails headless. | `echo {{ clipboard \| quote }}` |

### Interactive

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `input LABEL [default=""]` | Single-line text field in the fill dialog. Several tags with the same label share one value; the default comes from the first. | `{{ input "Message" \| quote }}` |
| `choice LABEL A B …` | Single-select list (type to filter); the first option is preselected. | `{{ choice "Env" "dev" "prod" }}` |
| `secret LABEL` | Masked field. The value is never logged, previewed, remembered, stored in the MRU or passed over MCP. | `{{ secret "Token" }}` |
| `cursor` | Emits nothing; marks where the shell's cursor ends up after a single-line, non-running insert. | `psql {{ cursor }}` |

## Filters

### Case

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `… \| upper` | Upper case. | `{{ input "X" \| upper }}` |
| `… \| lower` | Lower case. | `{{ input "X" \| lower }}` |
| `… \| title` | Title Case (words split on whitespace). | `{{ input "X" \| title }}` |
| `… \| snake` | snake_case. | `{{ input "X" \| snake }}` |
| `… \| kebab` | kebab-case. | `{{ input "Branch" \| kebab }}` |
| `… \| camel` | camelCase. | `{{ input "X" \| camel }}` |
| `… \| slug` | URL slug: lower-case alphanumeric runs joined by `-`. | `{{ input "Title" \| slug }}` |

### Text

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `… \| trim` | Strips leading and trailing whitespace. | `{{ last_output \| trim }}` |
| `… \| truncate N [ellipsis="…"]` | Shortens to at most N characters, ellipsis included. | `{{ input "X" \| truncate 20 }}` |
| `… \| replace FROM TO` | Replaces every occurrence of FROM (literal text). | `{{ input "X" \| replace " " "_" }}` |
| `… \| default VALUE` | VALUE when the input is empty. | `{{ input "X" \| default "none" }}` |
| `… \| silent` | Emits nothing. A binding made in the same tag still receives the value. | `{{ id := uuid \| silent }}` |

### Quoting

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `… \| quote` | POSIX single quotes (`'` becomes `'\''`; empty becomes `''`). | `{{ input "Message" \| quote }}` |
| `… \| dquote` | Double quotes, escaping `\ " $` and the backtick. | `{{ input "X" \| dquote }}` |
| `… \| json` | JSON string literal. | `{{ input "X" \| json }}` |

### Encoding

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `… \| urlencode` | Percent-encoding (unreserved characters are kept). | `{{ input "Q" \| urlencode }}` |
| `… \| base64` | Standard base64. | `{{ input "X" \| base64 }}` |
| `… \| base64d` | Decodes standard base64 (invalid input is a failure). | `{{ input "X" \| base64d }}` |

### Hashing

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `… \| sha256` | Lower-case hex SHA-256. | `{{ input "X" \| sha256 }}` |
| `… \| md5` | Lower-case hex MD5. | `{{ input "X" \| md5 }}` |

### Paths

| Signature | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `… \| basename` | Last path component. | `{{ cwd \| basename }}` |
| `… \| dirname` | Path without its last component. | `{{ cwd \| dirname }}` |
